title: Vite: written by Vue’s author, now used by everyone

videos.script:
Every page of the planner has come through Vite since lesson 1, and so far it has only been the thing that prints an address. Today it is the subject. {{story}} It was written by Vue's author, to stop bundling during development, and now most of the frameworks you have heard of start from it.

{{dev}} You will count what the browser asks the dev server for. Thirty-three requests, one per module, each converted when it is asked for. {{hmr}} Then a change saved while the page is open. One kind keeps the week you were looking at, one starts the component again, and one reloads the page, and you will see why.

{{build}} Then the build, where the thirty-three become four. {{config}} Then the configuration, and a port that refuses rather than moves. {{env}} Then environment variables, and the rule that decides which of them a stranger can read.

{{plugins}} And last, a plugin of the planner's own, which will not build while the data names a course that does not exist.
